observations: Opening asks whether a program's 0.1 plus 0.2 equals 0.3 without naming its number type.
Selecting binary fractions one-sixteenth, one-thirty-second and one-128th gave 0.1015625, explicitly over target.

Computer-storage view chose nearest twelve-switch approximation 0.10009765625 and contrasted its lower neighbor 0.099853515625; it showed common 53-bit stored values and printed sum 0.30000000000000004.
Reveal explains repeating binary expansion, nearest-value storage, decimal one-third analogy and whole-cent representation. All-off reset changed current switches while retaining storage explanation.
